trello.name: Renew and deploy wildcard SSL cert and rotate internal CA cert
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Renew the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com (expires September 1st) and deploy it to the load balancers by August 22nd to leave a buffer. In the same change window, also rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh (expires two weeks after the public one). Move both certificates onto cert-manager so they auto-renew going forward. Acceptance criteria: both certs renewed, deployed, and enrolled in cert-manager auto-renewal by August 22nd.

trello.name: Implement PDF export feature for reports
trello.desc: Owner: Aisha. Deliver the full PDF export feature for reports as a single deliverable with two halves: (1) backend renders the report to PDF using headless Chrome, and (2) frontend adds an export button and a progress state for large reports that take a few seconds. Upon completion, record a short demo GIF for the marketing changelog as part of finishing the feature. Deadline: end of month. Acceptance criteria: users can export reports to PDF via a frontend button with progress indication for large reports, and a demo GIF is produced for the changelog.

trello.name: Restore staging environment parity with production
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Two parts in one task: (1) Run the three pending migrations on staging today to bring it back in line with production. (2) Write a nightly job that diffs the staging schema against the production schema and posts a message to the infra channel if they diverge, preventing future drift. Acceptance criteria: staging schema matches production after running the three migrations, and the nightly diff job is deployed and posting to the infra channel on divergence.
